implementationSteps: REWRITE src/index.ts: replace the 3-line no-op stub with a SYNC `export default function (pi: ExtensionAPI): void` factory. Imports (with `.js` extensions, matching repo convention): `type { ExtensionAPI }` from `@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent`; `{ getConfig }` from `./config.js`; `{ setLogFile }` from `./log.js`; `{ resetRuntime, clearAll }` from `./runtime.js`; `{ contextHandler }` from `./filter.js`; `{ registerBloatReminder, registerTurnEndMetric }` from `./nudges.js`; `{ makeRewindTool }` from `./tools/rewind.js`; `{ makeShrinkTool }` from `./tools/shrink.js`; `{ makeCheckpointTool }` from `./tools/checkpoint.js`; `{ auditTool }` from `./tools/audit.js`.

In the factory body, in this order: (1) `setLogFile(getConfig().log.file);` — points the logger at the lazily-cached config (null default → off). (2) Register the 4 tools: `pi.registerTool(makeRewindTool(pi)); pi.registerTool(makeShrinkTool(pi)); pi.registerTool(makeCheckpointTool(pi)); pi.registerTool(auditTool);` (rewind/shrink/checkpoint are FACTORIES capturing pi; auditTool is a PLAIN const, read-only). (3) Attach handlers: `pi.on("context", contextHandler);` (INLINE — filter.ts exports the handler directly, not a seam); `registerBloatReminder(pi);` (→ pi.on tool_result, Nudge A); `registerTurnEndMetric(pi);` (→ pi.on turn_end, Nudge B Phase 1). (4) Lifecycle: `pi.on("session_start", (_event, ctx) => { resetRuntime(ctx.sessionManager.getSessionId()); });` (C12: read sessionId FRESH inside the callback; resetRuntime drops any stale runtime — freshRuntime sets tokenBaseline:null) and `pi.on("session_shutdown", () => { clearAll(); });`. Do NOT wrap the body in try/catch (fail-FAST on bootstrap; handlers self-protect fail-open). Do NOT make it async.

Test cases (cover CONTRACT §6 IMPLICIT TDD): (1) factory(pi) does not throw; (2) registeredTools names sorted == ["mulligan_audit","mulligan_checkpoint","mulligan_rewind","mulligan_shrink"]; (3) handlers Map has keys context, tool_result, turn_end, session_start, session_shutdown; (4) zero-config: do NOT call setConfig before the factory — it still registers 4 tools relying solely on lazy DEFAULT_CONFIG (enabled:true); (5) `setConfig({ enabled:false })` → captured context handler returns UNDEFINED when invoked with a minimal fake ctx (pass-through, E14); (6) with enabled:false, each of the 4 registeredTools' `execute("call-1", <empty-params>, undefined, undefined, ctx)` returns content[0].text starting with "Mulligan: refused — Mulligan is disabled."; (7) session_start handler invokes without throwing.
